newsitem.title: INDIA: India disinvestment report in February - Chidambaram.
newsitem.headline: India disinvestment report in February - Chidambaram.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Thursday that a government commission studying the possible sale of partial stakes in state-owned companies will submit its first report in February.
Last year the government asked the Disinvestment Commission to study the possibility of selling off partial stakes in 40 state-controlled companies.
"That commission has promised me that the first report will come in early February," Chidambaram told the Confederation of Indian Industry's annual meeting in Calcutta.
India aims to raise 50 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) by selling of shares in state companies.
